The young Barnard brothers, Peter and John were unfortunately omitted from the notable performers listed on page 15 of your handbook. On the track this year John won the South London Schools 100 yds. and Peter the Furlong.
Of particular merit are those of Arnold Bent (5'1" High Jump at the age of 13),D.Thorogate(132'10" Discus),and John Barnard (10.9sec 100yards and 2nd in the All England Schools Championships).
Recent instances have been D.Cocks,A.Fairclough,J.Bicourt,J.Vivian,J.Barnard and J.Mitchell;and there are numerous others good enough to rate first team selection in the Seniors when coming of age.

One of our most promising boys J.Lewis,is one of the Football fans and I am told on good authority that he is a most excellent player. Another is J.Barnard who I know has been sought as a member by a number of prominent clubs.

There were several outstanding races at this meeting - the most noteable being the Youth 100y in which John Barnard clocked 10.4,and the Junior 100y/220y where Bob Jones in his first ever try at these distances recorded 10.5/23.5 .

J.Lewis was 1st in the S/London Schools 880y - 2:11.0,and reached the final of the All England,finishing 7th with 2:08.0 J.Barnard won the S/London Schools 100y and was 2nd in the London Schools Champ
That promising young athlete John Barnard has decided to follow in the footsteps of Johnny Key (Fulham) and leave Belgrave for the "big-time" of first class football.

JOHN BARNARD, one of our most promising youths for the last two seasons, has now turned his attention to soccer in a big way. This talented all-round sportsman has been signed up by Plymouth Argyle and is looking forward to a long professional career.
